verses.en: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.sm: Ua tepa ae o ia, ua silafia o e mauoa, o lafo a latou taulaga i le mea e teu ai tupe.

verses.en: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
verses.sm: Ua silafia foi e ia le tasi fafine mativa ua oti lana tane, ua lafo i ai tupe iti e lua.

verses.en: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia, “E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o mea a lenei fafine mativa ua oti lana tane ua lafo i ai, ua sili leaia latou uma.

verses.en: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
verses.sm: Aua o i latou uma, ua latou lafo atu i taulaga nisi mea mai a latou mea ua tele; a o ia ua mativa, ua lafo e ia ana mea uma e ola ai sa ia te ia.”

verses.en: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
verses.sm: Ua tautalatala nisi i mea a le malumalu, i lona teuteuina i maa lalelei ma mea alofa, ona fetalai atu lea o ia,

verses.en: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.sm: “O ia mea ua outou vaavaai i ai, E 00 mai lava ona aso e le toe ai se tasi maa i luga o le tasi maa, a e uma ona sóloia i lalo.”

verses.en: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
verses.sm: Ona latou fesili mai ai lea ia te ia, “Le aʻoaʻo e, e taunuu ea ia inea afea? Se a foi le faailoga pe a tali taunuu ai ia mea?”

verses.en: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu o ia, “Ia outou, ne'i faaseseina outou; aua 2 toatele e o maii loʻu igoa, e taitasi ma faapea ane, O aʻu o ia; ma lenei foi, Ua latalata foi ona po. Aua foi tou te mulimuli atu ia te i latou.

verses.en: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
verses.sm: Pe a outou faalogo i taua ma fouvalega, aua tou te atuatuvale ; auá e ao ina muaj taunuu mai o ia mea, a e le oo loa mai le gataaga.”

verses.en: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, “E sii le taua e le tasi nuu i le tasi nuu, ma le tasi malo i le tasi malo.

verses.en: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
verses.sm: E i ai mafuie tetele i lea mea ma lea mea, O oge foi, ma faamai; ma faziteite ma faailoga tetele mai le lagi.

verses.en: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
verses.sm: A o lei 00 nei mea, latou te pupue ma faasaua ia te outou, e tuuina atu ia te outou i sunako ma fale puipui, latou te taʻitaʻiina atu outou i tupu ma kovana ona o loʻu igoa.

verses.en: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
verses.sm: O aso ia e avea ai vutou ma molimau.

verses.en: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
verses.sm: O lenei, ia tuu i o outou loto, tou te le muai mafaufau i se upu tou te tali atu ai.

verses.en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
verses.sm: Auā ou te avatu mo outou le upu ma le poto, e leai so latou o e finau mai ia te outou na te mafaia ona tali mai, pe tetee mai ia te outou.

verses.en: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
verses.sm: E tuuina atu foi outou e mātua, ma uso, ma aiga, ma uo; o isi foi o outou e fasiotia e i latou.

verses.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.
verses.sm: E inosia foi outou e tagata uma ona o loʻu igoa.

verses.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
verses.sm: A e leai lava so outou lauulu e tasi e paŭ.

verses.en: In your patience possess ye your souls.
verses.sm: O lo outou onosai tou te maua ai lo outou ola.

verses.en: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
verses.sm: “A iloa e outou ua siosiomia Ierusalema i ‘au o le taua, ia outou iloa i lea aso ua latalata lona faatafunaina.

verses.en: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
verses.sm: O lea aso, o e ua i Iutaia ia latou sosola i mauga; o e ua i totonu o lea aai, ia latou o ese; o e ua i le xao foi, aua neʻi latou o atu i totonu o le aai.

verses.en: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Aua o ona aso ia e faasalaina ai, ina ia taunuu mai o mea uma ua tusia.

verses.en: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
verses.sm: Oi talofa i fafine ua totò, atoa foi ma E failele i ia lava aso; aua e oo le puapuaga tele i le nuu, ma le toasa i le nuu nei.

verses.en: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.sm: E oti i latou i le mata o le pelu; e táfea foi i nuu uma; e solia foi Ierusalema e nuu ese, seia faaiuina tausaga o nuu ese.

verses.en: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
verses.sm: “E i ai foi faailoga i le la, ma le masina, ma fetu; e atuatuvale foi ma fememeai nuu i le lalolagi i le n o le sami ma le sousou,

verses.en: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
verses.sm: e matapogia foi tagata i le matatau ma le faatalitali i mea e oo mai i le lalolagi; aua e luluina ‘au a le lagi.

verses.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.sm: Ona iloa atu ai lea e i latou o le Atalii o le tagata e sau i le ao, ma le mana ma le mamalu tele.

verses.en: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
verses.sm: A afua ona faia o ia mea, ia tepa ae outou, ma ia ea i luga o outou ulu; aua e latalata ina faaolaina outou.”

verses.en: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu o ia ia te i latou i le faataoto; “Ina vaai ia i le mati atoa ma laau uma;

verses.en: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
verses.sm: pe a faatoa matala mai lau, ua outou vaai, ona outou iloa ai lea ua latalata le tau vevela.

verses.en: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
verses.sm: Ia faapea foi outou, pe a iloa e outou ia mea ua faia, ia cutou iloa ua latalata le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
verses.sm: E moni, ou te fai atu ia te ou- i latou. Ona latou fiafia lea, ua tou, E le mavae atu lenei tupulaga, seia taunuu mea uma.

verses.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.sm: E mavae atu lava le lagi atoa ma le lalolagi, peitai o au upu, e le mavac atu lava ia.

verses.en: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
verses.sm: “la outou, neʻi mafatia O outou loto i le soona ulavale, ma le ona, ma le popole i mea a le olaga nei, neʻi faafusei mai lea aso ia te outou e pei o se mailei;

verses.en: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
verses.sm: ana e 00 mai ai i e nonofo uma lava i le fogaeleele uma.

verses.en: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
verses.sm: O lea ia outou mataala e le aunoa ma tatalo ina ia outou maua le malosi e sao mai ia mea uma ua tali oo mai, ma ia tutu i luma o le Atalii o le tagata.”

verses.en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
verses.sm: Sa masani o ia e aʻoaʻo atu i le malumalu i le ao; a o le po, ua maliu atu ai ia i tua, ma nofo i le mauga o Olive le igoa.

verses.en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
verses.sm: Ua malama ae le taeao, ona o ane ai lea ia te ia o le nuu uma i le malumalu e faalogologo ai ia te ia.
